description: Unit test class for Orleans' CachedGrainLocator, focusing on registration, lookup, cache management, and interaction with the grain directory and membership service.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocatorTests
classes.description: Test suite for Orleans' CachedGrainLocator, covering registration, lookup, cache cleanup, and race conditions.

methods.name: RegisterWhenNoOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registration of a new grain activation when no prior entry exists; verifies cache update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registration when another entry exists; validates overwrite and cache consistency.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressMatches
methods.description: Tests registration with a matching previous address, ensuring proper overwrite.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests registration with a non-matching previous address; expects no overwrite.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Simulates registration when the existing entry points to a dead silo; expects cleanup and cache update.

methods.name: LookupPopulateTheCache
methods.description: Tests remote lookup populating the local cache.

methods.name: LookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Ensures dead silo entries are invalidated during lookup.

methods.name: LocalLookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Tests that local cache lookup skips directory for dead silo entries.

methods.name: CleanupWhenSiloIsDead
methods.description: Verifies cache cleanup and directory involvements when a silo becomes dead.

methods.name: UnregisterCallDirectoryAndCleanCache
methods.description: Tests unregistering an address and cache clearance.

methods.name: UnregisterRemovesFromCacheFirst
methods.description: Checks that cache is cleaned before directory unregister operation completes.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupSameId
methods.description: Simulates race condition between unregister and lookup for the same GrainId.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupDifferentId
methods.description: Tests race conditions between unregister and lookup for different GrainIds.
